name: Teltonika Router Indicator
description:
Shows the cellular status (network type, band, signal, operator) of a Teltonika router running RutOS 7.x in the top bar. Optional SIM switching, default SIM and data limit actions.

Zeigt den Mobilfunk-Status (Netztyp, Band, Signal, Betreiber) eines Teltonika-Routers mit RutOS 7.x in der oberen Leiste.
